name: nexus-wiki-html-preview
description: Wiki document block with left HTML editor and live preview

scripts.build-web: npm run build -w nexus-wiki-html-preview-web-main && npm run build -w nexus-wiki-html-preview-web-edit
scripts.start-web: concurrently -n view,edit "npm run start -w nexus-wiki-html-preview-web-main" "npm run start -w nexus-wiki-html-preview-web-edit"
